records.title: Clean Nuclear Energy Corp. Uranium Exploration Permit Application
records.description: Proposed uranium exploration project seven miles north of Edgemont, SD. Up to 50 holes will be drilled to a maximum vertical depth of 700 feet. In addition, 50 drill platforms will be created with a dimension of 60 feet by 60 feet. Exploration will be conducted using reverse circulation drilling with sumps.

records.title: 2915-2 Powertech (USA), Inc.
records.description: An application for a water permit to appropriate water from the Madison Aquifer for industrial use in a uranium in-situ mining project (Dewey-Burdock) located in southwestern Custer County & northwestern Fall River County, as well as domestic and rural water system purposes intended to service landowners in and around the project area.

records.title: 2052-1 Peter Sobotka
records.description: Application for a water permit to appropriate 0.40 cubic feet of water per second from an infiltration gallery to be completed into the Quaternary Aged Alluvium (approximately 30 feet deep) located in NE 1/4 NW 1/4 Section 29 for irrigation of 80 acres located in the E 1/2 NW 1/4, W 1/2 NE 1/4, NE 1/4 NE 1/4 Section 29; all in T6N-R5E. This site is located in Meade County, approximately four and one-half miles east of Whitewood SD.

records.title: 2049-1 Stanley R Goschke
records.description: Application for a water permit to appropriate up to 10 acre-feet of water annually at a maximum pump rate of 0.17 cubic feet of water per second from one well to be completed into the Minnelusa Aquifer (approximately 260 feet deep) located in Lot 1 of Lot E NW 1/4 SW 1/4 Section 20-T4N-R6E, for a water distribution system and domestic purposes located in the same area.
